meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查网页和界面的显示效果，输出截图与结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常调整界面，想快速确认外观没有变坏。
copy.tagline_en: Inspect web, terminal, or paginated UI and get a screenshot-based verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you update UIs often and want to double-check appearances before sharing.

howto.what: 构建或改动界面后，Claude 会截图取证、跑自带脚本比对，再并行派两个只读审查子代理，最后按页给出 PASS/REVISE/FAIL 判定和定位到页面的问题。
howto.when: 构建或改动界面后（网页、终端 TUI、分页文档），或你问某页面、组件、终端界面看起来对不对时触发。

say.text: 帮我对这个页面做一次视觉 QA
say.note: 截图取证、跑脚本，再派两个子代理出判定。

say.text: 这个终端 TUI 的边框和宽字符有没有错位？
say.note: 跑宽度检查，输出溢出行与边框对齐结果。

say.text: 按这份参考稿比对这个页面渲染得对不对
say.note: 逐视口截图比对，并核对是否只是贴图。

howto.what_en: After a UI build or change, Claude captures screenshots, runs the bundled evidence script, dispatches two read-only reviewer passes, and gives a per-page PASS/REVISE/FAIL verdict with located findings.
howto.when_en: Triggered after building or changing any UI (web, terminal TUI, paginated documents), or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

say_en.text: Run a visual QA pass on this page
say_en.note: Captures, diffs, then dispatches two reviewers for a verdict.

say_en.text: Do this TUI's borders and wide chars overflow or misalign?
say_en.note: Runs the width check on the capture.

say_en.text: Compare this page's render against the reference packet
say_en.note: Per-viewport diffs; checks it isn't just a pasted image.
